data.action: 立于书架木梯怀抱星图古籍，微红耳根回眸
data.animaCaption: Standing on a wooden library ladder with a stack of leather-bound star atlases in her arms, she looks back over her shoulder with a faint blush in the afternoon window light.
data.camera: 全身镜头，螺旋书架纵深构图
data.description: 摆放着古老星象手稿的螺旋书架图书馆内，尤诺身着银扣立领衬衫与藏青百褶裙，踩在移动木梯上怀抱厚重星图典籍回眸。
data.lighting: 高窗洒入的清亮午后阳光与书页微尘
data.location: 七丘神殿螺旋星象图书馆
data.promptProse: Halfway up a rolling wooden ladder in Septimont's celestial archive, Iuno hugs a stack of gilded star atlases in a silver-buttoned blouse and navy pleated skirt, glancing back over her shoulder.
data.title: 尤诺 · 螺旋星象图书馆抱书阶梯回眸
